'''Velma's Gratitude''' is a [[special]] [[condition]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

It can only be put into play by an encounter at [[Velma's Diner]].

==Card info==
'''Condition''': [[Investigator]]s may ignore any money losses caused by [[Velma's Diner]] [[encounter]]s and are always considered to have spent the maximum amount of money allowed during encounters there.
